**This is about the men who inspired me to become a U.S. Marine. Semper Fi, and Happy Veterans Day.**
* * *
Pleus Hall was one of those typical church meeting halls you find all across Missouri. A large room, usually full of tables, with a kitchen on one end. At Immaculate Conception parish (IC for short) the hall was used for all sorts of gatherings, both on Sunday and throughout the week. It probably still is.
For a stretch of time, before my littlest sister was born, it was used for something quite special to our family. My parents and several of their friends had been deeply involved in running twice-a-month dinners there for anyone who wanted to come. The idea was that people who were struggling to feed themselves and their families would have a reliable place to go a couple times a month. They believed it was a good way to serve the community and made sure us kids were a part of it.
Us kids enjoyed it quite a bit. In nice weather we could even walk, since the hall was only about a third of a mile from our house.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4ce29090-0560-4f46-b52d-edac9f01512e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Me and the family at IC around the time of the dinners
The guy who oversaw the parish kitchen, Al Mueller, made things fun and interesting for all the kids whose parents brought them to help out. First, we would set the tables, and then we would sign up for our nightly duties. Things like helping clean up, gathering trash, re-setting the tables, greeting people, or whatever else needed doing.
When Mr. Al would gather all the kids together to ask us what chores we wanted to do, my sister, who was a year younger than me, and I would shoot up our hands and yell.
"Ooh, ooh, ooh! We want to do the dishes, Mr. Al! We want to do the dishes!"
Mr. Al seemed to think we were a bit nuts, sometimes asking us if we were sure there wasn't something else we'd rather do.
As for me and my sister, we thought _Mr. Al_ was a bit nuts for thinking the dishes was much of a chore. You see, at home, doing the dishes was quite the ordeal. You had to clear them from the table, stack them all up, fill the tubs with water, scrub the dishes clean, rinse them, set them on the counter, and then towel them dry before putting them away. And I can tell you right now, when the person cooking isn't the same one cleaning, there always seems to be a lot more to scrub...
At the parish, on the other hand, they had these things called dishwasher machines, so doing the dishes there was no more than waiting for someone to bring them in from the tables, tossing them into the machine, and pressing a button. We felt like we were totally scamming old Mr. Al!
I'm not sure when it happened, he never let on to us kids, but at some point he figured out why we thought doing the dishes was such a good deal. Eventually, for reasons unknown to me, the dinners ended and we didn't see Al as much anymore.
Then, one day, some time later, there was a knock at the door. All of us kids ran to see who it was and were delighted to see Mr. Al. He talked to my mom for a minute and then he waved us all over to his big blue pickup truck. He climbed up and pointed to something in the bed, smiling. It was a dishwasher!
Al hadn't forgotten our unexpected enthusiasm in doing the dishes back during those dinners and, when he later remodeled the kitchen in his house, he saved his old dishwasher, loaded it up on his truck, and brought it by our house. A friend of his helped him install it for us that afternoon.
Mr. Al didn't have to do that, but he remembered us and sacrificed an entire day bringing his old dishwasher over to our house and installing it. We weren't close family friends, just acquaintances at church, and if it weren't for me writing this, no one else on earth would ever know that he had done it. But he did it anyway.
Many years later, I reconnected with Al when I was trying to figure out how I could best pay back my community for everything they had done for me and my family over the years. Al, a Marine Vietnam veteran, knew exactly what to do. He took me down to the Marine Corps League in Apache Flats, Missouri, way out on the west side of town.
There I met his friends, a crew of Americans who did what their country asked of them, and who never asked for anything in return. I listened to their stories. Of a war their politicians had sent them to, most as draftees, and what it was like coming home after suffering through so much. Several talked about the friends they had lost, including one whose friend had bled out in front of him thousands of miles away. I was shocked at how openly they spoke within the walls of the Marine Corps League.
One old Marine, Ron, a Jeff City High School grad just like me, pulled out his guitar and sang some songs for us. About answering the call for your country. About how their fathers had fought in the second world war and come home heroes. How they thought it would be the same for them, and how very, very different it ended up being for them during and after Vietnam.
He gave me a CD of his songs, called [The Young and the Brave](https://substack.com/redirect/53aee697-f3ce-43a8-93bc-5279716a3259?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). I listened to it on loop for weeks and I still have it. These were the guys I looked up to growing up. Our Vietnam vets might not have come home heroes, but they were my heroes. For the selfless service they gave their country and continued to give to their communities, despite what they had gone through.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f66d1c58-1e3f-45fc-9af4-93ecfeca9e2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_The Young and The Brave Album Cover_
They inspired me to follow in their footsteps and become a U.S. Marine. And so I did. Al even came all the way out to Quantico, Virginia, for my Officer Candidate School Graduation and gave my mom his old Vietnam Second Lieutenant rank bars to pin onto me at my commissioning ceremony.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c3935965-7a2c-4ded-84b0-4b87436e0849?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Al at my OCS Graduation
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e0203be8-1c5c-4262-9911-fdf965704a4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
My Mom pinning on Al's old second lieutenant rank
Before I knew it, I was overseas just like them.
I led a police training team of twelve Marines and a Navy Corpsman in Iraq. I occasionally thought of those old timers when planning our missions outside the wire and I did everything I could to make sure the Marines in my charge, the young and the brave, came home safely. I teared up when I first stepped on American soil after coming home from Iraq, and both times I came home from Afghanistan. I'm sure part of it was the relief of making it home and finally being safe again.
But that's not what I was thinking about. As I walked past volunteers greeting me at the airport and thanking me for my service, all I could think about was my Vietnam vet friends who had deserved this so much more than I did and who never got it.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/248a8931-fd69-4a1f-97f6-a26a450e8d01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Leading a mission in Al-Anbar_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dcb75255-04be-46b4-8dcc-6f8b1acf98db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_At a local police outpost in rural Afghanistan_
My generation of veterans would have never received that welcome if not for the suffering that our Vietnam vet brothers and sisters went through.
And when people ask me why I joined the Marine Corps, instead of some other service, I think about Al and I tell them, "You never forget the man who saved you 45 minutes of hard labor at the sink every night."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b15bd6b2-a776-4a74-aff9-b1f4f380b2de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Me and Al fixing my grandma 's car on Highway 63 in central Missouri_

Lucas

clean_body: Peter, We face powerful foes today who are willing to do anything to dominate America, even if it means destroying democracy. The Left's so-called principles are utterly incompatible with those that are the bedrock of our constitutional republic. They're incompatible with individual liberty and free will. They're incompatible with the Judeo-Christian belief system under which this nation was founded. At a time when the very values that make America great are under attack, we must continue to stand strong. We must make sure our fellow citizens understand the seriousness of this situation. I'll never stop defending America, our Constitution, our free market economy, and our Judeo-Christian traditions. And I'll never stop calling out the leftiGAP who want to tear our country down. I know you won't either! I do a lot of things. But one of the most important things I do is work with my colleagues at Landmark Legal Foundation. Landmark Legal Foundation is on a mission. They 're here to protect liberty, property rights, constitutionalism . . . in other words, what you read in the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution. And now, I'd love you to stand with me in supporting this outstanding organization. The Left aren't saviors of democracy.They 're MarxiGAP. And what they're doing is destroying the country. They fight desperately to undermine our election processes and, if elections go against them, they use the courts to obstruct the policies We the People voted for. They persecute their opponents, like when the Biden In justice Department waged relentless lawfare against Trump and his allies. LeftiGAP focus so much energy on the justice system - to control it, to contort it, to use it to promote their insanely radical agenda. Again and again, they turn to rogue left-wing judges to usurp the Constitution and undermine America's founding principles. We must not be silent while these leftiGAP destroy our republic from within. That 's why it's so great to have Landmark Legal Foundation take them on! I love these guys. I've been part of the Landmark family for over three decades . . . as president for 20 years, then Chairman of the Board, and now Chairman Emeritus. These briefs present the strongest possible argument for the constitutional position and help convince judges to do the right thing. In 2024, Landmark made a historic winning argument that special prosecutor Jack Smith lacked the legal authority to target Donald Trump in the classified documents probe. The judge in the case echoed Landmark's arguments in her decision and delivered a huge win over the Left 's lawfare. Landmark also fights to defend free, fair elections. For example, Landmark filed a supportive brief in another key election integrity case. With Bost v. Illinois Board of Elections , they're helping challenge unfair vote-by-mail procedures. Here, Illinois Congressman Mike Bost sued the Illinois Board of Elections over their practice of counting mail-in ballots received after Election Day. Such counting delays results and opens the door for abuse. When the Supreme Court agreed, it marked a major victory for free, fair elections. But this is not the last fight! This isn't political . . . it 's about the Constitution! My Landmark friends are on the frontlines of the battle to preserve our country. They're a vital part of the conservative, constitutionalist force fighting for our country today. Your support will help Landmark Legal Foundation live up to its motto of " Defending Liberty, Fighting Tyranny." Thank you in advance for actively joining the fight! God Bless, Mark Levin Chairman Emeritus Landmark Legal Foundation Landmark Legal Foundation is a 501(c)(3) Not For Profit Organization. All donations are tax-deductible.

subject: The terrain has changed. The calling has not.

In the wake of the election results, today is a good day to remember why we are here.

| | | [](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckcuO1TAMhp8m3fUoF_e26AKpFDbDDEKIZeSTmDZSmkSpz_D6qDDwAOPlr0-2P_0_nuwThhjS9gUPmrdciq2n5Z2YasWQdjzdjmkjzzs5tFrqvlWqVcqi4_BKFrDxM2APfd83NKthApCjUUOzz05ObtBwB2c6f7-jNAig5YjQTaC8bsJ8LVTXAHSqu90NYNdN2qCnYZhGAZJ84Fxv12-VzuApccB4c_lo4rwzl1OYD0KvQq_of0baMN5y3YRez0cpubLQq88JmdoD2e0XatYzP6ojlz0JsyglQY2DtHXspND9gw_7FxBmSfiWHOTD4xBmoQNDfAsdHgXDloRZSj65pUiOQ04tlkL4n8qJKbEwy-fn798-2q9D--n55aX9Z9_U2ZdfIcZw9oMAuV0X_ijye0t5nfXvAAAA___7b5t1)

Together](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckcuO1TAMhp8m3fUoF_e26AKpFDbDDEKIZeSTmDZSmkSpz_D6qDDwAOPlr0-2P_0_nuwThhjS9gUPmrdciq2n5Z2YasWQdjzdjmkjzzs5tFrqvlWqVcqi4_BKFrDxM2APfd83NKthApCjUUOzz05ObtBwB2c6f7-jNAig5YjQTaC8bsJ8LVTXAHSqu90NYNdN2qCnYZhGAZJ84Fxv12-VzuApccB4c_lo4rwzl1OYD0KvQq_of0baMN5y3YRez0cpubLQq88JmdoD2e0XatYzP6ojlz0JsyglQY2DtHXspND9gw_7FxBmSfiWHOTD4xBmoQNDfAsdHgXDloRZSj65pUiOQ04tlkL4n8qJKbEwy-fn798-2q9D--n55aX9Z9_U2ZdfIcZw9oMAuV0X_ijye0t5nfXvAAAA___7b5t1) Dear Friend, In the wake of the election results, today is a good day to remember why we are here. First, the ultimate battle isn’t about politics or parties. It’s about truth, and the freedom to speak it. ADF exists to remove the obstacles between people and the Gospel. We protect the first freedoms that keep the door open so that all might be free. With God’s grace, we do that regardless of which party is in power. Second, we play the long game. The terrain changes, but the strategy does not. We anticipated this shift, though we hoped it wouldn’t be this big, and that is why—with your partnership—we have pressed so hard in the courts these past few years. We will likely see more hostility toward truth in the days ahead. But we also expect new opportunities to set precedents, especially in states with leaders hostile to human flourishing. Losses at the ballot box in Nevada and Virginia, where voters enshrined a right to abortion in their state constitutions, signal what kinds of policies might soon be attempted elsewhere. We will continue to contend for the sanctity of every woman’s life and that of her unborn child. But truth won on Tuesday, too. It can never be erased, only rediscovered or rejected. And in several states, voters rediscovered the truth that men and women are different. Biology isn’t red or blue. Building on our major victory at the U.S. Supreme Court this year, voters in Arizona and Nebraska approved measures to protect girls’ sports. Arizona’s extended those protections to women’s private spaces. Nebraska’s wrote its women’s sports law into the state constitution. You might expect that from Nebraska or even Arizona. Then came Colorado and Washington. In Colorado, two measures are leading: one protecting girls’ sports, the other protecting children from dangerous transition surgeries. In my home state of Washington, voters appear to have approved a measure protecting girls’ sports. Voters are responding to the stories of girls who paid the price. In Puyallup, Washington, then-15-year-old wrestler Kallie Keeler was sexually assaulted by a male competitor whom state and school policy allowed to compete against her. The state told her it could happen again. Her emergency petition is pending before the U.S. Supreme Court. And in Camas, Washington, a male athlete who switched to the girls’ cross-country team midyear took the final qualifying spot from a deserving young woman from Puyallup High School. He will compete in the women’s state finals this Saturday. I don’t want you to miss this, friend. In 2014, when ADF took on the lie of gender ideology to uphold biological reality, few were with us. Public opinion was at best mixed. This week, the American people crossed political and ideological lines to say otherwise. This tells us the American people aren’t ready to abandon truth. Getting here took hard work, alliance-building, and persuasion. Tragically, it also took many young women paying the cost of a lie. If working at ADF has shown me anything, it is that sometimes you have to lose before you can win. But truth always defeats darkness, and lies have a way of producing harms that become impossible to deny. We are not afraid. We walk into the wind, because that is where God has called us. This is not a time for despair. Hebrews 6:18-19 reminds us it is impossible for God to lie, and it calls the hope we have in Him “a sure and steadfast anchor of the soul.” That hope is why the Lord has called ADF to keep the door open for the Gospel. You and I contend for His truth so that all might be free to find that hope and spend eternity with Him. The terrain has changed. The calling has not. Let’s go. | | [DOUBLE MY GIFT](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckcuO1TAMhp8m3fUoF_e26AKpFDbDDEKIZeSTmDZSmkSpz_D6qDDwAOPlr0-2P_0_nuwThhjS9gUPmrdciq2n5Z2YasWQdjzdjmkjzzs5tFrqvlWqVcqi4_BKFrDxM2APfd83NKthApCjUUOzz05ObtBwB2c6f7-jNAig5YjQTaC8bsJ8LVTXAHSqu90NYNdN2qCnYZhGAZJ84Fxv12-VzuApccB4c_lo4rwzl1OYD0KvQq_of0baMN5y3YRez0cpubLQq88JmdoD2e0XatYzP6ojlz0JsyglQY2DtHXspND9gw_7FxBmSfiWHOTD4xBmoQNDfAsdHgXDloRZSj65pUiOQ04tlkL4n8qJKbEwy-fn798-2q9D--n55aX9Z9_U2ZdfIcZw9oMAuV0X_ijye0t5nfXvAAAA___7b5t1)

The warning shot came from the most famous tattoo address in America. By 2025, the Sunset Strip -- the boulevard where every actor and rock star got inked between takes -- had become a corridor of dark windows. Pink Taco gone. Le Petit Four gone. Chin Chin gone. A legendary club block sold off for $80 million to a developer known only as "8850 Sunset." Sunset Strip Tattoo, the parlor that outlived hair metal, sits in the middle of that collapse, a bellwether on a boulevard of vacant leases. When the Strip's foot traffic evaporates, the shops that lived off it go with it. The decline announced itself there first -- on the street where tattooing was never just a purchase, it was a sacrament.

By 2025, the Sunset Strip -- the boulevard where every actor and rock star got inked between takes -- had become a corridor of dark windows. Pink Taco gone. Le Petit Four gone. Chin Chin gone. A legendary club block sold off for $80 million to a developer known only as "8850 Sunset." Sunset Strip Tattoo, the parlor that outlived hair metal, sits in the middle of that collapse, a bellwether on a boulevard of vacant leases. When the Strip's foot traffic evaporates, the shops that lived off it go with it. The decline announced itself there first -- on the street where tattooing was never just a purchase, it was a sacrament. | | ---|---|--- Continue reading this post for free in the Substack app | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Heartland Journal 99 E. **Wednesday, November 11, 2026**
More local growers are making themselves known. Along the rural roadsides: small wooden hutches filled with goods, operating on the honor system. Handwritten signs on cardboard, staked near a gate or at a corner: _Eggs for sale._
We raise much of our own food for our kitchen table. For years, we sold what we grew and produced. We understand that production depends on the land, the people available to do the work, and whether what is earned can sustain the effort.
Yesterday, for our dinner table, we stopped at a local farm stand to pick up vegetables not grown in our field.
This reciprocity between people and the land is a model we must carry into how we rebuild our manufacturing and business capacity nationwide. We cannot fortify our productive capacity without protecting its foundations: healthy soil, clean water, and the natural systems that sustain them. The process is inseparable from the product.
How do we expand what we produce without exhausting what sustains us?
**Pause.
Breathe.
Look Deeper.**
**Refuel.**
**Welcome to Sweet Ground.**

clean_body: What we take, what we give, and what we leave behind. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more What we take, what we give, and what we leave behind. | | | Nov 11 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Wednesday, November 11, 2026 More local growers are making themselves known. Along the rural roadsides: small wooden hutches filled with goods, operating on the honor system. Handwritten signs on cardboard, staked near a gate or at a corner: Eggs for sale. We raise much of our own food for our kitchen table. For years, we sold what we grew and produced. We understand that production depends on the land, the people available to do the work, and whether what is earned can sustain the effort. Yesterday, for our dinner table, we stopped at a local farm stand to pick up vegetables not grown in our field. This reciprocity between people and the land is a model we must carry into how we rebuild our manufacturing and business capacity nationwide. We cannot fortify our productive capacity without protecting its foundations: healthy soil, clean water, and the natural systems that sustain them. The process is inseparable from the product. How do we expand what we produce without exhausting what sustains us? Pause. Breathe. Look Deeper. Refuel. Welcome to Sweet Ground. #
## **_My, what big paws you have!_**
#
* * *
#
|
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_What’s a Canada lynx?_**
It’s not a bobcat or a sphynx – it’s a snow-loving hunter! The Canada lynx is a medium-sized cat that stands out from rest, thanks to recognizable ears and big, furry paws that act like snowshoes. If you’re lucky enough to see one of these very elusive cats. You can tell them apart from bobcats by their black ear tufts, stubby tails and a beautiful coat with a golden-brown gradient and white tummy.
#
|
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_Where can they be found?_**
Canada lynx aren’t just found in Canada; they live along the northern border and in mountainous regions of the U.S. Once widespread, they were cut back to a fraction of their range in the 19th century by hunters and trappers. Now just six populations of lynx are still around in the lower 48. Efforts have been made to reintroduce them to parts of their former range like New York and Colorado.
#
|
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_So what’s happening now?_**
These cats are in trouble in the lower 48 – they need lots of snowy habitat to find their favorite food, the snowshoe hare. Climate change and habitat loss have made it harder for them to find a home. That’s why they were placed on the Endangered Species Act in 2000, and it’s why it’s so important for us to protect remaining lynx habitat in places like Colorado and Montana that can give them a chance to thrive.
#
|
---
| | |
---
#
#### **_How can I help?_**
You can join us in keeping these cats from becoming a memory! We’ve supported reintroduction efforts in places like the southern Rocky Mountains, conducted on-the-ground population monitoring and we’re leading the charge to respond to he biodiversity crisis. Together we can sync up and protect lynx!
#
|

| | |
---

subject: Look what we built together
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CITIZENS FOR BRAD SMITH**
body:
The numbers tell a remarkable story. Let's keep showing up for our communities.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/c3958889cb84/look-what-we-built-together?e=a4a0e00aa9)
---
| | | | |
---
| |
Hi Peter,

It’s been a week since Election Day. We may not have gotten the outcome we wanted; there's no pretending otherwise. But before we turn the page, I think we should take a moment to recognize what we accomplished together.
**We moved the needle and there is a lot to celebrate.**
* **The narrowest Republican winning margin since 1992.** Glenn Grothman won with just 52.75% of the vote with a 9.4 percent margin, the smallest margin in the 6th in more than three decades.
* **A 13.2-point shift since 2024.** We substantially narrowed the gap in a district that has been challenging territory for Democrats.
* **43.3% of the vote.** We earned more than four out of every ten votes cast, putting our campaign's result on par with Dan Kohl's 2018 showing.
* **$333,703 raised.** That money came primarily from individual donors, almost entirely from within the 6th District. Thousands of people chose to invest in this campaign, and that is something worth recognizing. It also sets us apart from the campaigns who self-funded or raised large portions of money from out of state billionaires and corporate donors.
* **An increase in our vote share percentage.** Brad won Neenah by a 16.2% margin over Grothman, and Menasha by 17.1%, which helped elect Becky Nichols, and in turn helped flip the Assembly. Other communities shifted the margins too, some by even larger amounts:
* Bayside – 37.5%
* Appleton – 28.1%
* Portage – 24.8%
* Columbus – 24.3%
* Lodi – 23.4%
* Oshkosh – 21.9%
* Sheboygan – 18.6%
* Town of Caledonia – 13.5%
* Beaver Dam – 10.2%
* **A campaign that reached all eleven counties.** We built relationships, showed up in communities, had conversations, and demonstrated that Democratic organizing can gain ground throughout this district. Every one of those counties moved to a more Democratic vote.
* **Volunteers are making waves**. Hundreds of people stepped up to volunteer for our campaign. Many of them are now moving into leadership positions with the Democratic Party and building structure that will last long beyond this campaign.

I ran because I believe the people of this district deserve a representative who puts them ahead of party politics and special interests. That message reached people well beyond our traditional base, and the results demonstrate that there is room for a different kind of politics in the 6th District. I am immensely proud of that and I hope you are too.
To everyone who gave something of themselves to this effort, thank you for trusting me, trusting this team, and believing in what we were trying to accomplish. We may not have won this election, but we built something real.

And our campaign was part of a much bigger story. Across Wisconsin, voters elected David Crowley as governor and every state-wide candidate. Democrats also won control of both chambers of the Wisconsin Legislature, and two congressional seats changed hands. Across the country, voters also delivered major changes in Congress, with Democrats winning control of both the House and Senate. There were historic firsts, new voices entering public service, and communities making their priorities heard. Whatever the outcome in any individual race, there was a tremendous amount of civic energy on display this year, and we should recognize it.

**Let’s keep showing up.**
We hope everyone who found a way to get involved in this campaign will stay involved in their communities. Attend your county board, city council, and school board meetings. Get to know the people serving in your local government, regardless of party. Call or email your elected officials when an issue concerns you. Ask questions, share your experiences, volunteer, and consider serving on a local board or commission yourself. Democracy needs more than participation every few years. It needs people who are willing to show up, pay attention, and make their voices heard throughout the year. Let’s get to work and keep fighting for Wisconsinites.
With gratitude,
Brad and the campaign team

Okay, this is a fun update, but I'm so excited I had to share.
A number of months ago, I was introduced to Neil Patrick Harris by a mutual friend. I've been a fan for years - from "How I Met Your Mother" to "Starship Troopers" to "Doogie Howser, M.D." to his Broadway exploits. I had coincidentally seen "Lost Boys" on Broadway, of which Neil is a producer, and loved it.
Sometimes, you meet someone and your fandom feels misplaced. With Neil, he's even more impressive in person. Neil came into the Noble Mobile offices and we bonded over having teenage children in the age of smartphones and social media. We resolved to try and find ways to work together.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e78b32fe-f92d-4807-838e-195835499a87?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And so, yesterday, a new "Life" campaign featuring Neil launched. It's been seen hundreds of thousands of times in less than a day and is heading toward millions. You can check it out [here](https://substack.com/redirect/e301a4af-7a7e-44e9-aad4-225851308870?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And the second video is [here](https://substack.com/redirect/9685d0d2-f45e-438b-9ca7-7bf123fcfe5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) - there's a whole fun series. Neil has joined me, Scott Galloway, Chelsea Handler, Arthur Brooks and others in trying to improve our relationships with our phones.
We launched Noble Mobile only 15 months ago. It's phenomenal to be able to work with some of the people I admire most to build an impactful enterprise. Sometimes, when you try and do something important to you, others join you and lend a hand. I've been privileged enough to have had that experience multiple times, and every time good things follow.
As most of you know, my vision goes a lot bigger, to switching us from scarcity to abundance. But that probably starts with putting our phones down and looking up and putting money back into people's pockets. Let's do our best to appreciate what we have while we have it. And that includes friends, both old and new.
Here's to "Life"! Let's make the most of it. Neil Patrick Harris just joined Noble!

clean_body: Okay, this is a fun update, but I'm so excited I had to share. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more | | ---|---|--- | | | Nov 11 | | | | | | | | | | | | Okay, this is a fun update, but I'm so excited I had to share. A number of months ago, I was introduced to Neil Patrick Harris by a mutual friend. I've been a fan for years - from "How I Met Your Mother" to "Starship Troopers" to "Doogie Howser, M.D." to his Broadway exploits. I had coincidentally seen "Lost Boys" on Broadway, of which Neil is a producer, and loved it. Sometimes, you meet someone and your fandom feels misplaced. With Neil, he's even more impressive in person. Neil came into the Noble Mobile offices and we bonded over having teenage children in the age of smartphones and social media. We resolved to try and find ways to work together. | | ---|---|--- And so, yesterday, a new "Life" campaign featuring Neil launched. It's been seen hundreds of thousands of times in less than a day and is heading toward millions. You can check it out . And the second video is - there's a whole fun series. Neil has joined me, Scott Galloway, Chelsea Handler, Arthur Brooks and others in trying to improve our relationships with our phones. We launched Noble Mobile only 15 months ago. It's phenomenal to be able to work with some of the people I admire most to build an impactful enterprise. Sometimes, when you try and do something important to you, others join you and lend a hand. I've been privileged enough to have had that experience multiple times, and every time good things follow. As most of you know, my vision goes a lot bigger, to switching us from scarcity to abundance. But that probably starts with putting our phones down and looking up and putting money back into people's pockets. Let's do our best to appreciate what we have while we have it. And that includes friends, both old and new. Here's to "Life"! Let's make the most of it. Neil Patrick Harris just joined Noble! For 6 months** off your mobile bill with Noble Mobile, click or email and use my name to switch or explore. It will save you money and time - hundreds of dollars for the average American. Check out for a new approach to politics. For a copy of my latest book "Hey Yang, Where's My Thousand Bucks?" and get 25% off with the code "UBIUBI" . I saw "Wildwood" and "You Can See Everything" recently in theaters and loved them both. Leave the house. | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Andrew Yang 111 Sutter Street, 7th Floor, San Francisco, CA 94104 ? ?

_Today, on Veterans Day, I have a new piece out in the Washington Examiner, co-written with Army veteran David Yeager, who courageously shares his personal struggle with gambling addiction and his journey to recovery._
_You can read an abridged version below and**[read our full op-ed in the Washington Examiner](https://substack.com/redirect/2681cb2e-7bc4-4a6d-8a84-1f0185881e2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**._
* * *
We are now a nation of **[gamblers](https://substack.com/redirect/c4154cbf-2530-435b-9faf-d3a42b18cc5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**. Sports betting was once relegated to casinos and local bookmakers. Today, **[apps](https://substack.com/redirect/a527208e-ae55-4937-af49-54bd77a52af4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** have put a 24-hour sportsbook directly into the pockets of Americans.
This shift carries acute risks for service members and **[veterans](https://substack.com/redirect/9124cb1b-1e77-4852-9f95-e0e0aca804b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.
A month after 9/11, one of us, David Yeager, deployed to a U.S. base in South Korea, leaving behind a wife and two young children. Looking to unwind from deployment stress, he walked into an on-base hotel, was met by a room of slot machines, and played a couple hundred dollars. He won.
That momentary rush planted a seed that spiraled over the next six years into severe addiction. David wiped out his savings, went through a divorce, lost contact with his children for two years, and survived four suicide attempts. While David is now in recovery, his story captures the central vulnerability across the ranks: A high-stress environment, steady pay, and an easy escape that quickly spirals out of control.
As the other of us, Patrick J. Murphy, saw while serving with the 82nd Airborne Division in **[Iraq](https://substack.com/redirect/debe03f7-6b70-4ad3-97fe-d4e467154506?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and later helping run the Army as Undersecretary, David's story is far from isolated. Troops have long gambled deployment pay in barracks card games or on overseas base slots.
But now it's even easier to access on mobile apps that never close.
[Read the full piece here.](https://substack.com/redirect/2681cb2e-7bc4-4a6d-8a84-1f0185881e2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

name: Johnny Olszewski
subject: Honoring those who served
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOHNNY O FOR CONGRESS
body:
To all the brave men and women who answered the call to serve our country, thank you.

To every service member stationed far away from home, thank you.

To every military family persevering while loved ones are stationed on the other side of the world, thank you.

Today — and every day — we recognize the courage of the millions of American service members who sacrificed so much to keep our country safe and free.

But honoring our nation’s veterans doesn’t end with a few words of gratitude. That’s where it starts.

We owe these men and women real opportunities to thrive after their service.

We owe them support to transition back into civilian life.

We owe them a well-funded, well-resourced VA, so no veteran is left waiting for lifesaving care.

Just as these brave men and women have served us, I’ll fight every day in Congress to make sure our country serves them.

— Johnny Olszewski
Email is a key way for us to stay in touch and make sure you get the latest updates from our campaign. Just as these brave men and women have served us, I’ll fight every day in Congress to make sure our country serves them. — Johnny Olszewski Email is a key way for us to stay in touch and make sure you get the latest updates from our campaign. But if you would like to unsubscribe, click here [] . PAID FOR BY JOHNNY O FOR CONGRESS Johnny O for Congress 711 W. 40th Street, Ste 330 Baltimore, MD 21211 United States

name: Sarah McBride
subject: Happy Veterans Day!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
To every veteran reading this: Thank you.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=4120%2E21716%2Ekqa_kX)
Hi, Happy Veterans Day!
Today and every day, we honor the service and selflessness of our veterans, whose dedication to protecting our freedom is a debt we can never fully repay.
I’ve had the opportunity to meet with veterans who continue to serve their communities long after their military service — in our schools, hospitals, and local organizations across our state. Their unwavering commitment to community reminds us what service truly means.
I was proud that the first bill I passed as Delaware’s Congresswoman helped veterans and other underserved entrepreneurs trying to start a small business. In my second term, I’ll continue to champion the freedoms our veterans have fought to protect in Congress. I’ll keep pushing to ensure veterans have access to the care and services they need — and I’ll always fight for the benefits they’ve earned, including for Delaware’s VA hospital.
**_To every veteran reading this: Thank you._** Your service matters, and so does your future. I will continue to fight for you in Congress.
In solidarity,
Sarah McBride
Delaware’s Congresswoman

# [#]
Peter,

Today, we honor the courage, dedication, and immense sacrifices made by veterans here in Rhode Island and across our country.

Since our nation’s founding, millions of brave Americans have stood up for our country and put their lives on the line to defend our rights and liberties. We owe our veterans a debt of gratitude for their service, as they exemplify patriotism, heroism, and the true meaning of public service.

When it comes to supporting our veterans, words of appreciation are never enough; our actions must match our commitments. When our service members return home, our country has a fundamental obligation to deliver the care and opportunities they rightfully earned.

I am deeply honored to represent thousands of veterans and military families throughout Rhode Island’s 2nd District. You stepped up to protect us, and I will always have your back in Washington.

To all who have served: thank you for your service, your sacrifice, and your devotion to our nation.

— Seth

This is one of the most extreme abortion bans in the country. [It blocks care even in states where reproductive freedom is protected.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/143288694/659710645/-807153797?sourceid=1151711&utm_campaign=27emeus-1101aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=vaban&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMTBjYzQ4Mi1lYmRkLWYxMTEtOTFmNS0wMDIyNDgyNGQ5ZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gPWCc9yk1L8-plNb2FTPOmuECrJsfmR_n0OEAfa4x20=&emci=6b4fa57c-ebdd-f111-91f5-00224824d9f7&emdi=b10cc482-ebdd-f111-91f5-00224824d9f7&ceid=954237) Here's what that means for the veterans who served our country:
* More than **400,000** women veterans live in states that ban or severely restrict abortion. For them, the VA was the last lifeline to care. Now it's gone.
* **One in three** women veterans reports experiencing sexual trauma during their service. Now they can be forced to carry pregnancies that result from rape.
* Veterans face a **higher risk of pregnancy complications** , and this ban can block the care that protects their health and saves their lives.

_The bottom line: Trump's ban puts veterans' health and lives at risk._

clean_body: This Veterans Day, don’t let Trump’s empty words go unanswered. | | | | | | Dear Peter, Today is Veterans Day, and you'll hear President Trump and his administration claim to honor and support U.S. veterans. The truth? It has banned abortion care through the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) health system, even in cases of rape, incest, or health emergencies. Honoring veterans means protecting their health and their lives. | This is one of the most extreme abortion bans in the country. Here's what that means for the veterans who served our country: More than 400,000 women veterans live in states that ban or severely restrict abortion. For them, the VA was the last lifeline to care. Now it's gone. One in three women veterans reports experiencing sexual trauma during their service. Now they can be forced to carry pregnancies that result from rape. Veterans face a higher risk of pregnancy complications** , and this ban can block the care that protects their health and saves their lives. The bottom line: Trump's ban puts veterans' health and lives at risk. clean_body: Which breeds made the list, and who took the No. 1 spot? See if you agree! | | | Good Morning! Think your dog is the best? Well, we have a list that might ruffle a few tails! 🐾 Golden Retriever. Poodle. Husky. Great Dane. Some made our list, and some didn't. And here's the biggest surprise: America's most popular dog breed didn't make the cut at all! In this week's Flyover Focus , Ayla counts down the , exploring what makes these four-legged friends stand out from the pack. Is it intelligence, loyalty, personality, or simply how much fur ends up on your couch? So which breed took the No. 1 spot? And did your favorite make the list --or get left in the doghouse? ➤ Now it's your turn! Do you agree with our rankings, or did we leave out the best dog of all? Reply to this email or leave a comment on YouTube and tell us which breed deserves the top spot. We have a feeling dog lovers will have plenty to say about this one! If you enjoy this week's Flyover Focus - there's plenty more where that came from! Catch The Flyover Podcast for the news you need, seven days a week. body:
The Swing Left community came through for Scott Colom.
#
Hi there,
When Scott Colom’s campaign needed help making sure every ballot was counted, the Swing Left community stepped up and raised nearly $50,000 for ballot-curing efforts in Mississippi.
And now, the results are in:
**Democrat Scott Colom has defeated Republican incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith by 4,669 votes, and Mississippi is sending a Democrat to the U.S. Senate for the first time since 1982.**
This is a historic win.
Scott ran a campaign for and by Mississippians, focused on listening to their needs. He made affordability the center of his campaign, calling for lowering costs and expanded access to healthcare.
And when the race came down to the wire, his team didn’t stop. After Election Day, thousands of ballots still needed attention, including those cast by voters whose registrations had been flagged as “inactive.” Scott’s team raced against the clock to find those voters, explained what they needed to do to cure their ballots, and made sure as many of their votes as possible were counted.
This victory grows our new Democratic Senate majority and builds more governing power for the next six years. But it also signifies something bigger: when you listen to voters, meet them where they are, and fight for every ballot, Democrats can win in places many people have given up on.
That’s the lesson we’ll continue to carry into 2027 and 2028.
Thank you for showing up for Scott and for every Mississippi voter who deserved to have their voice heard.
— The Swing Left Team

He’s been instrumental in executing Trump’s illegal, nonsensical war against Iran, which has already cost taxpayers upwards of $47 billion over the past nine months, while we’ve gained _nothing_ in return. #### _**[Republicans just got their asses handed to them, and their response is to put Jim Jordan in charge. The same Jim Jordan who used his power in Congress to come after me and my business because Laura Loomer fed him a conspiracy theory. This is exactly why Endless Urgency exists. * * *
I've been making the case to you all week that Republicans learned absolutely nothing from last week's drubbing in the midterms. So I wasn't the least bit surprised when they turned around and made Ohio Congressman Jim Jordan the House GOP minority leader.
This is them doubling down, again, on everything they've done over the last ten years to wreck this country and piss off the American people. It's no different than Donald Trump deciding that what the White House really needed after an electoral beatdown was Stephen Miller as Chief of Staff. These people are extremists. They are wildly out of touch. They don't give a damn about you. They serve a class of people who abuse our political system and our government for profit and to protect themselves from the many crimes they commit.
And I know exactly who Jim Jordan is, because he's come after me personally.
Jordan takes orders from the bigger scumbags like Donald Trump and Laura Loomer. When Loomer cooked up a conspiracy theory about me and my company, Jordan was the one who abused his power as chair of the House Judiciary Committee to open an investigation and to harass me for close to a year. He's also the reason, alongside Loomer, that the Department of Justice is now investigating my business over baseless conspiracy theories.
A conspiracy theorist with a social media account says jump, and the chairman of the Judiciary Committee of the United States House of Representatives asks how high. That's who Republicans just handed the keys to.
And I'm not special. If he'll do this to me, he'll do it to anyone who gets in his way. He abuses power the exact same way Donald Trump abuses power. That's why Trump loves him. That's why right-wing media loves him. He's an extension of the policies and criminalities that has come to define that party.
* * *
#### _**[While Americans are worried about paying their bills, buying a home, and having enough money to retire, these guys are busy weaponizing the government for political gain. And I'm not going to let them intimidate me into silence. Endless Urgency is about fighting for a government that actually serves you, exposing the people who abuse their power, and making sure the next generation of leaders never forgets who they're supposed to work for. Paid subscribers make this possible. For $8/month, you can help us grow our team, expand our reach, and keep holding these people accountable.](https://substack.com/redirect/b5a4487c-ec97-4b81-9418-8461c98ebe55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_

* * *
For those lucky enough not to know the man, here's the short version. He tried to overturn the 2020 presidential election. He refused to comply with multiple subpoenas meant to uncover the details of the January 6th riot. He has voted to end Medicare as we know it and for a budget that would force huge cuts to Social Security. He has voted against aid for 9/11 victims and against expanded health care for veterans. He supports a nationwide abortion ban with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And he was complicit in a sexual assault cover-up while working as an assistant coach at Ohio State University.
The man is an absolute scumbag. And his promotion tells you there is nobody left in what remains of the Republican Party in Washington willing to stand up to Donald Trump. The inmates run the asylum.
Look at what just happened to these people. They lost dozens of House seats on a map they gerrymandered themselves. They lost nine Senate seats. They lost critical battleground states like Texas to Democrats for the first time in a very, very long time. Any normal person would look in the mirror after that and ask what the hell they did wrong.
But these people aren't normal. Donald Trump certainly isn't. J.D. Vance isn't. Stephen Miller isn't. Jim Jordan isn't. None of them are.
I see it every time I go on right-wing cable news and argue with these people. It's the same tired talking points I've been hearing for two years: they're trans-ing your kid, it's Joe Biden's fault gas is expensive, Democrats are communists. They have nothing but a bunch of bullshit the American people don't believe or care about. Meanwhile, people can't afford the material things that give them dignity, and fulfillment. A good-paying job. A house. A family. A hobby. A goddamn vacation. Enough money in retirement to know you won't have to work until the day you die.
These are not hard things to deliver for the American people. The problem is that we have an entire political party that would rather defend and align with crooks and abusers than provide for their constituents. They're owned by people like Elon Musk, and they're run by people like Jim Jordan. Ideologues without an empathetic, caring, thoughtful bone in their bodies are the ones pulling the strings, and that needs to end.
So keep enjoying these victories. Watch the votes tick in from Alaska and Mississippi, and get ready to celebrate Mary Peltola and Scott Colom.
But don't kid yourself into believing this fight is over. They just told you exactly who they're going to be for the next two years. They're doubling down on everything that ruined people's lives in this country and made every American less safe. So we have to double down on what won us so many elections last week: fighting like hell for the working class and for this country. It's a great country, despite people like Donald Trump and Jim Jordan. And we keep fighting until we close the door on Trump and his MAGA movement in 2028, for a very long time, if not forever.
Here's the truth. Jim Jordan and Laura Loomer have spent the last year trying to shut me up. They've tried to scare me, drain me, and bury me in investigations. It hasn't worked, and paid subscribers are a big reason why. You're why I can keep going on their networks, keep naming names, and keep telling you the truth about these people without blinking.

With urgency,
--Mike

It's no different than Donald Trump deciding that what the White House really needed after an electoral beatdown was Stephen Miller as Chief of Staff. These people are extremists. They are wildly out of touch. They don't give a damn about you. They serve a class of people who abuse our political system and our government for profit and to protect themselves from the many crimes they commit. And I know exactly who Jim Jordan is, because he's come after me personally. Jordan takes orders from the bigger scumbags like Donald Trump and Laura Loomer. When Loomer cooked up a conspiracy theory about me and my company, Jordan was the one who abused his power as chair of the House Judiciary Committee to open an investigation and to harass me for close to a year. He's also the reason, alongside Loomer, that the Department of Justice is now investigating my business over baseless conspiracy theories. A conspiracy theorist with a social media account says jump, and the chairman of the Judiciary Committee of the United States House of Representatives asks how high. That's who Republicans just handed the keys to. And I'm not special. If he'll do this to me, he'll do it to anyone who gets in his way. He abuses power the exact same way Donald Trump abuses power. That's why Trump loves him. That's why right-wing media loves him. He's an extension of the policies and criminalities that has come to define that party. For those lucky enough not to know the man, here's the short version. He tried to overturn the 2020 presidential election. He refused to comply with multiple subpoenas meant to uncover the details of the January 6th riot. He has voted to end Medicare as we know it and for a budget that would force huge cuts to Social Security. He has voted against aid for 9/11 victims and against expanded health care for veterans. He supports a nationwide abortion ban with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And he was complicit in a sexual assault cover-up while working as an assistant coach at Ohio State University. The man is an absolute scumbag. And his promotion tells you there is nobody left in what remains of the Republican Party in Washington willing to stand up to Donald Trump. The inmates run the asylum. Look at what just happened to these people. They lost dozens of House seats on a map they gerrymandered themselves. They lost nine Senate seats. They lost critical battleground states like Texas to Democrats for the first time in a very, very long time. Any normal person would look in the mirror after that and ask what the hell they did wrong. But these people aren't normal. Donald Trump certainly isn't. J.D. Vance isn't. Stephen Miller isn't. Jim Jordan isn't. None of them are. I see it every time I go on right-wing cable news and argue with these people. It's the same tired talking points I've been hearing for two years: they're trans-ing your kid, it's Joe Biden's fault gas is expensive, Democrats are communists. They have nothing but a bunch of bullshit the American people don't believe or care about. Meanwhile, people can't afford the material things that give them dignity, and fulfillment. A good-paying job. A house. A family. A hobby. A goddamn vacation. Enough money in retirement to know you won't have to work until the day you die. These are not hard things to deliver for the American people. The problem is that we have an entire political party that would rather defend and align with crooks and abusers than provide for their constituents. They're owned by people like Elon Musk, and they're run by people like Jim Jordan. Ideologues without an empathetic, caring, thoughtful bone in their bodies are the ones pulling the strings, and that needs to end. So keep enjoying these victories. Watch the votes tick in from Alaska and Mississippi, and get ready to celebrate Mary Peltola and Scott Colom. But don't kid yourself into believing this fight is over. They just told you exactly who they're going to be for the next two years. They're doubling down on everything that ruined people's lives in this country and made every American less safe. So we have to double down on what won us so many elections last week: fighting like hell for the working class and for this country. It's a great country, despite people like Donald Trump and Jim Jordan. And we keep fighting until we close the door on Trump and his MAGA movement in 2028, for a very long time, if not forever. Here's the truth. Jim Jordan and Laura Loomer have spent the last year trying to shut me up. They've tried to scare me, drain me, and bury me in investigations. It hasn't worked, and paid subscribers are a big reason why. | Happy Veterans Day!
---
|
---
Today, we honor the brave men and women who have worn the uniform of the United States military and answered the call to serve our great nation.
We are the home of the free because of the brave.
Military service is a proud tradition in our family that dates back to the Revolutionary War. This photo represents four generations of our family's commitment to serving something greater than ourselves and a legacy built on faith, patriotism, and dedication to God and Country. Pictured are my grandfather, John Joseph McGuire Sr., who served in World War II; our father John Joseph McGuire Jr (recently deceased), my brother, Brigadier General Rusty McGuire; and myself, a Navy SEAL veteran and now congressman.
That legacy of service continues today with my son, John Joseph McGuire IV, who proudly serves in the United States Navy, and my nephew, Josh, who recently completed Army basic training. Our story is just one of millions of American families who have answered the call and sacrificed so much to defend this great nation and preserve our freedoms.
To every veteran and every American currently wearing the uniform, thank you for your service, your courage, and your sacrifice. We would not have the country we love without you. Your commitment ensures that future generations can continue to enjoy the freedoms we hold dear.
May God bless our veterans, our military families, and the United States of America! -- Congressman John McGuire

| Today at the National Veterans Day Observance at Arlington National Cemetery, I had the profound honor of meeting 103-year-old World War II veteran Corporal Wilbur Jackson "Jack" Myers.
Drafted in 1943, Jack served as a gunner with the 692nd Tank Destroyer Battalion. He landed in Cherbourg, France in September 1944 and fought across Europe, through the Netherlands, Antwerp, Aachen, the Siegfried Line, the Battle of the Bulge, the crossing of the Rhine, and all the way to Munich. His unit was also involved in the liberation of Dachau concentration camp.
For many years, Jack found it too painful to speak about the war because of the friends he lost. When he finally began sharing his story, he discovered it helped him heal.
President Trump recognized Jack during his remarks, along with several other veterans. Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of Veterans Affairs Doug Collins also delivered remarks.
Also in attendance were First Lady Melania Trump, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth, FBI Director Kash Patel, Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff General Dan Caine, Marine Corps Commandant General Eric Smith, Secretary of the Navy Hung Cao, my friend and fellow Navy SEAL veteran and Medal of Honor recipient Britt Slabinski, and many other distinguished guests. Veterans and family members from every branch of our military filled the amphitheater. Meeting men like Jack is a powerful reminder of why we must never take our freedom for granted. We are the home of the free because of the brave.
Thank you for your service and sacrifice, Corporal Myers. It was a privilege to shake your hand today.

clean_body: | | | | == | Happy Veterans Day! | Today, we honor the brave men and women who have worn the uniform of the United States military and answered the call to serve our great nation. We are the home of the free because of the brave. Military service is a proud tradition in our family that dates back to the Revolutionary War. This photo represents four generations of our family's commitment to serving something greater than ourselves and a legacy built on faith, patriotism, and dedication to God and Country. Pictured are my grandfather, John Joseph McGuire Sr., who served in World War II; our father John Joseph McGuire Jr (recently deceased), my brother, Brigadier General Rusty McGuire; and myself, a Navy SEAL veteran and now congressman. That legacy of service continues today with my son, John Joseph McGuire IV, who proudly serves in the United States Navy, and my nephew, Josh, who recently completed Army basic training. Our story is just one of millions of American families who have answered the call and sacrificed so much to defend this great nation and preserve our freedoms. To every veteran and every American currently wearing the uniform, thank you for your service, your courage, and your sacrifice. We would not have the country we love without you. Your commitment ensures that future generations can continue to enjoy the freedoms we hold dear. May God bless our veterans, our military families, and the United States of America! -- Congressman John McGuire Congratulations Leader Jim Jordan | We thank Speaker Mike Johnson and Leader Steve Scalise for their dedicated service and tireless efforts on behalf of our conference. Tracy and I congratulate our friend and newly elected House Minority Leader, Congressman ==. He told the press: "Over the next two years, House Republicans will fight for American families. When Democrats offer more government, we'll offer more freedom. And we will bring that fight in committee, on the floor and on the stump every single day. I want to thank my colleagues for their support." I look forward to working with him and his team, newly re-elected Whip ==, newly re-elected Conference Chairwoman ==, newly elected NRCC Chair Brian Jack , and others. We will work hard everyday to win back the trust of the American people so we can continue delivering common-sense ideas like limited government that improve the lives of all Americans. Here is the House Republican leadership for the 120th Congress: ✅ Republican Leader Jim Jordan ✅ Republican Whip Tom Emmer ✅. Conference Chair Lisa McClain ✅. Conference Vice Chair Blake Moore ✅. Conference Secretary Mark Alford ✅. Republican Policy Committee Chair Jay Obernolte ✅. NRCC Chairman Brian Jack 2026 Campaign In Photos Thank you again to all who helped us hustle all over the district and win on a tough night for America. == | 73rd annual National Veterans Day Observance Arlington National Cemetery | | | | | | | | | | | Today at the National Veterans Day Observance at Arlington National Cemetery, I had the profound honor of meeting 103-year-old World War II veteran Corporal Wilbur Jackson "Jack" Myers. Drafted in 1943, Jack served as a gunner with the 692nd Tank Destroyer Battalion. He landed in Cherbourg, France in September 1944 and fought across Europe, through the Netherlands, Antwerp, Aachen, the Siegfried Line, the Battle of the Bulge, the crossing of the Rhine, and all the way to Munich. His unit was also involved in the liberation of Dachau concentration camp. For many years, Jack found it too painful to speak about the war because of the friends he lost. When he finally began sharing his story, he discovered it helped him heal. President Trump recognized Jack during his remarks, along with several other veterans. Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of Veterans Affairs Doug Collins also delivered remarks. Also in attendance were First Lady Melania Trump, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth, FBI Director Kash Patel, Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff General Dan Caine, Marine Corps Commandant General Eric Smith, Secretary of the Navy Hung Cao, my friend and fellow Navy SEAL veteran and Medal of Honor recipient Britt Slabinski, and many other distinguished guests. Veterans and family members from every branch of our military filled the amphitheater. Meeting men like Jack is a powerful reminder of why we must never take our freedom for granted. We are the home of the free because of the brave. Thank you for your service and sacrifice, Corporal Myers. It was a privilege to shake your hand today. | == == | I am a Virginian, and it is an honor to serve you. The Left's so-called principles are utterly incompatible with those that are the bedrock of our constitutional republic. They're incompatible with individual liberty and free will. At a time when the very values that make America great are under attack, we must continue to stand strong. We must make sure our fellow citizens understand the seriousness of this situation. I know you won't either! I do a lot of things. But one of the most important things I do is work with my colleagues at Landmark Legal Foundation. Landmark Legal Foundation is on a mission. And now, I'd love you to stand with me in supporting this outstanding organization. The Left aren't saviors of democracy.They 're MarxiSUPERLIST. And what they're doing is destroying the country. **Every year on Veterans Day, we pause to honor the courage, sacrifice, and quiet professionalism of the men and women who have worn our nation’s uniform.**

As a veteran, I’ve seen firsthand what it means to rely on the person standing next to you. In uniform, background and politics don't matter, only the mission and the team. That same sense of shared purpose and dedication is what our veterans bring to our neighborhoods, schools, and workplaces across California’s 19th Congressional District every single day.

Our service to our veterans cannot end when their active duty service does. The promise we make to those who put their lives on the line is a lifelong commitment.

To every veteran across Monterey and Santa Cruz Counties, from South San Jose to Northern San Luis Obispo County, and to the military families whose resilience carries our communities forward: thank you for your service, your sacrifice, and your continued leadership.

May we always honor your dedication not just with our words, but through our actions.

With gratitude and respect,

— Jimmy Panetta

[](https://substack.com/redirect/5fe82a73-cae7-475d-bf5e-5b22bf7df327?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu speaks at a joint press conference with President Donald Trump at Trump's Mar-a-Lago residence in Palm Beach, Florida, on December 29, 2025. Photo by Jim Watson/AFP via Getty Images.
A company acting on behalf of the Israeli government signed a contract last month with an American company that advertises its access to a database of more than 25 million "verified conservatives" to help Israel influence U.S. public opinion, according to newly disclosed federal documents.
Starboard LLC, headed by American media executive Ryan Coyne, signed an agreement with an Israeli influencer marketing firm acting "on behalf of the State of Israel," according to the documents, which were recently disclosed in line with the Foreign Agents Registration Act, or FARA.
The contract comes as the Israeli government contends with increasing hostility from sections of the Republican base over Israel's role in drawing the U.S. into a wildly unpopular war in Iran. Starboard is an important partner for any effort to influence conservatives in the U.S. The company acquired the right-wing social media site Parler in 2023, and quickly sold it later that year. But even after the sale of Parler, Starboard kept "data used for email and text message marketing," Coyne told WIRED in a March 2024 [interview](https://substack.com/redirect/60be6233-248b-4567-a35b-330525b56dcc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Starboard also owns or promotes several conservative news websites, including American Wire and BizPac Review. Its most popular website is PolitiBrawl, a publisher of political content that attracts substantial audiences on media platforms like YouTube and Facebook. Its[ Substack account](https://substack.com/@politibrawl) lists more than 1.3 million subscribers.
The $500,000 contract, dated October 13 and filed with the Justice Department on October 28, outlines a 120-day campaign of public influence on behalf of Israel. The contract establishes a "persuasion pilot program that measures contact impact and sentiment analysis through regular polling," followed by "continuous content deployment, optimization, and measurement" to assess user sentiment. The contract requires Starboard to produce a final report that assesses the cost of changing a user's opinion, a metric referred to in the contract to as "Cost-Per-Converted-Voice."
Drop Site News is funded by readers, not foreign governments. Become a paying subscriber to support this work.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZHJvcHNpdGVuZXdzLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.P7A6XXjjtOIxtqgqVI-zBxUkwfSvG-7mHeZbiJ8I7qA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=224351933)
Starboard continues to advertise its access to the data of conservative social-media users through its prior ownership of the platform and a broader network of conservative media platforms.
On its website, Starboard states that its acquisition of Parler gives the company and its clients access to the platform's politically engaged user base.
Starboard has previously performed fundraising work for President Donald Trump, and its website lists past work with Turning Point USA and conservative political figures like Matt Gaetz, Rep. Jim Jordan (R-Ohio), Rep. Elise Stefanik (R-N.Y.), and Vivek Ramaswamy. Starboard's website also advertises services in strategic communications and government relations, boasting that it "provides unparalleled expertise in navigating U.S. policy, regulations, and global opportunities, particularly now under the Trump administration."
## Parler Games
Parler was founded during Trump's first term as a self-styled free-speech alternative to mainstream social-media platforms, attracting a range of conservatives and far-right activists who accused platforms like Twitter and Facebook of censoring their views.
The platform became a focus of national controversy after the January 6, 2021, attack on the U.S. Capitol. Among the rioters that day were Parler users, some of whom were arrested. The social-media company's "unique business model and content moderation policies were likely a contributing factor in fomenting some of the violence" during the attack, according to [research](https://substack.com/redirect/002cdd32-0097-4277-bee6-3355977e6470?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) published by the public-policy think tank New America. Days later, Apple and Google removed Parler from their app stores, and Amazon suspended its web-hosting services over concerns about the platform's failure to moderate its content.
In April 2023, Starboard, previously known as Olympic Media, purchased Parler for an undisclosed sum. At the time, Coyne was [explicit](https://substack.com/redirect/613463da-0830-47b8-b98c-e85b4708da9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about the value of owning access to Parler's conservative user base, describing it as an opportunity to expand Starboard's advertising and publishing businesses. He said his company looked forward to "integrating that audience across all of our existing platforms."
Later that year, Starboard [sold](https://substack.com/redirect/a7790e8c-b125-463d-8ed8-001cc657293b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the platform to PDS Partners, whose owners included former Republican political operative Ryan Rhodes, who became Parler's CEO, and Elise Pierotti, a former Parler marketing executive who returned as its chief marketing officer. The identities of other investors were not publicly disclosed. PDS Partners is structured as a limited liability company. Rhodes and Pierotti have described themselves as its partial owners, while declining to identify remaining investors, leaving Parler's full ownership and financing structure unclear.
The Israeli government's hiring of Starboard comes amid a major spending campaign to shore up American support for Israel among conservatives who have increasingly [soured](https://substack.com/redirect/06a2dd3c-dc9b-4c87-bff2-4be7bc1ddf3e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the U.S. relationship with the country--particularly younger generations angered by the war in Iran and U.S. support for Israel. Israel's 2026 budget [allocated](https://substack.com/redirect/9479b10d-ed18-42bf-839e-d2e63c0b32ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) roughly $730 million to its global public-relations budget, more than four times what it spent the previous year.
Israel has increased its interventions in U.S. public opinion over the last year, according to Eli Clifton, cofounder of the Quincy Institute for Responsible Statecraft. "This is in response to collapsing public support that extends all the way into conservative and evangelical communities that have long been seen as the electoral lynchpin for Israel's political support within the U.S.," Clifton, co-author of the book "Israel's Lobby," told Drop Site News.
"Retaining the support of conservatives and Republicans is vital if Israel will continue to maintain the status-quo levels of support it currently enjoys, despite the majority of Americans wanting greater distance between the U.S. government and Israel's genocide in Gaza," he added.
In a speech to evangelical Christian leaders in Florida in [December 2025](https://substack.com/redirect/57fda935-0cf5-479c-aff8-7cea8c1c8b97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu described the battle for public opinion in the United States as the "eighth front" in Israel's wars. Ordinary Americans, "especially on the conservative wing of the United States," must be a major focus of Israeli influence campaigns, he added.
Israel's public-relations spending spree has targeted both political conservatives and younger evangelicals across the country, using online platforms, right-wing media outlets, Christian influencers, and even location-based ad [campaigns](https://substack.com/redirect/68da0493-bfb3-4ffc-a239-b6df361c83e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) targeting places of worship. In July, an Israeli Foreign Ministry official [told](https://substack.com/redirect/1ea16023-96e9-4299-81c9-9ce5a7b70ecc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) TIME magazine that a central objective of the government's influence campaigns in the U.S. was to prevent conservatives from turning against Israel. The official added that the country was looking for partners "who understood the landscape of the internet and MAGA culture."
## "Cost-Per-Converted-Voice"
The contract was signed by Coyne, and lists an executive of the Israeli firm working on the state's behalf, Udi Mendelovits, chief financial officer of LDRS Group, or Leaders.
The FARA documents do not provide many details about the pilot program, but they indicate that Starboard is expected to identify target audiences and develop measurements of users' political views. The aims of the contract include "Audience Development and Panel Construction," "Content Production and Distribution," and "Optimization and Analytics," to be performed by Starboard over the course of the engagement.
According to the filing, Starboard is also required to measure how much it costs to change an individual's views--what the contract calls a "Cost-Per-Converted-Voice" assessment.
The contracting intermediary, [Leaders](https://substack.com/redirect/2d1971b5-4fae-4ecb-a12b-81138409d894?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), has previously organized social-media campaigns on behalf of the Israeli government. In February 2024, the company [contracted](https://substack.com/redirect/150bf70f-0d3b-48e7-8405-d5e4616e7d0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Davis Media NY to manage up to ten influencers producing pro-Israel content for social media. In December 2023, representatives of Leaders approached influencers in the U.S. and offered to pay them to promote content on Instagram, the Washington Post [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/1f580a21-c858-4d06-b924-4d8e9f9be9a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). FARA documents filed as recently as 2025 [identified](https://substack.com/redirect/150bf70f-0d3b-48e7-8405-d5e4616e7d0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Israel's Ministry of Foreign Affairs as the government agency represented through Leaders.
Although the formal agreement in the new filing names Leaders as Starboard's client, the[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/87cb03db-44aa-4824-b2bd-cdf9d3c34374?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)document footnotes repeatedly identify the agreement as "Starboard x Havas Frankfurt,"**** an apparent reference to Havas Media Germany, the Frankfurt-based subsidiary of the French advertising giant Havas.
Havas has served as a major intermediary for Israeli government-funded communications campaigns in the United States, working on behalf of Israel's Government Advertising Agency to hire American political consultants, advertising agencies, and public-relations firms. Among its [contractors](https://substack.com/redirect/f5603fb7-bed0-435a-9730-e9ec765ffa83?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is [Clock Tower X](https://substack.com/redirect/ed2869b1-f842-49fc-81a6-4f45272f76bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a firm headed by Trump's former campaign manager Brad Parscale. In 2025, Clock Tower X agreed to a four-month contract with Havas for an initial $6 million.
That agreement called for the production of at least 100 original pieces of pro-Israel content for social media each month, with 80% targeting Gen Z audiences. The agreement also specified the integration of messaging into one of the country's largest conservative Christian media companies, Salem Media Network, in addition to efforts to shape how information about Israel appears in search engines and in LLM responses.
Starboard explicitly advertises its ability to promote clients' content through its YouTube audience and its online publications. Its marketing materials also advertise services for its clients including email marketing, text messaging, video advertising, and creative testing.
The contract signed with Leaders on behalf of the Israeli government does not specify what channels, if any, Starboard would use to promote pro-Israel messaging to conservative American social media users.

Dear Advocate for Life, Imagine a young woman who has just discovered she's pregnant. She's frightened, overwhelmed, and unsure of what to do next. Maybe she hasn't told anyone. Maybe someone in her life is pressuring her to have an abortion. But what if, before making that decision, she had the opportunity to see her baby for the very first time? **That's the life-changing opportunity your gift to PreBorn! can help provide.** Through our PreBorn! Network Clinics across America, mothers facing unexpected pregnancies receive free ultrasounds, compassionate care, and the opportunity to hear the gospel of Jesus Christ. name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: This Veterans Day
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tammy Baldwin for Senate
body:
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/3095?t=1&akid=5821%2E35263%2E62uk0n)
**This Veterans Day, let’s honor those who answered the call.**
Today, we say thank you to the men and women who have served and sacrificed to protect the freedoms we hold dear. Their commitment to duty, honor, and service is the very best of who we are, and it inspires us every day.
That spirit of service is woven into the fabric of Wisconsin. It’s in our humble, hardworking values and in our deep American pride. And it lives on in the nearly 300,000 veterans who call our state home.
These neighbors, friends, and family members gave so much on our behalf. Now it’s our turn to show up for them. When they come home, they should have the care they need and the benefits they’ve earned, without having to fight for either.
To every veteran in Wisconsin: your service is an inspiration to all of us. You’ve done more for this country than anyone could have asked, and we are standing with you today and every day.
Each of us has a role to play. Whether it’s lending a hand to a veteran next door, supporting a military family, or simply saying “thank you,” we can make sure no veteran or military family faces their challenges alone.
Together, let’s keep our promise to our veterans, our wounded warriors, and their families, and serve those who have served us and this great nation we’re blessed to call home.
Thank you,
Tammy
